item.shooting_star_demo.stellar_remote.h: Press the [%s] key, and something seems to happen
item.shooting_star_demo.magic_item.hint: Right click: cast the selected skill · %s: skill menu · Sneak + right click: next skill
Flip the cover and press the button. A red laser from space marks the ground in your crosshair, and eighteen seconds later a railgun hanging in the dark just past the Milky Way's rim fires down it: a beam 200 blocks in radius (set it from 10 to 1500 on the slider under it) that kills everything inside and cuts the whole column of the world away, from the build limit to the void. Stand in the strike zone and it takes you too; in creative you are pulled clear of it first. The damage slider under it sets each of its hits from 2 up to ∞, and at ∞ nothing it hits survives. Its speed slider plays the whole skill, film and all, from 0.3× to 3× as fast.

subtitles.shooting_star_demo.gungnir_win: Shock wave rolls over the land
Flip the cover and press the button. Your crosshair is marked in ember, and sixteen seconds later SS-03 Gungnir — a black needle a kilometre long, loaded into an accelerator ring round Jupiter and spun up seven laps — comes down on the mark straight out of the zenith, faster than its own sound. It strikes in silence: a shock ring planes the land 400 blocks round (power 4×; from 0.1× to 20× on the slider under it) flat to the ground it struck, into a molten crater round the needle, burning its telemetry into the land, and only when the ring has passed does the boom arrive. Everything in the zone dies, you too unless you are in creative, and past it the shock still throws and hurts whatever it meets. The needle stays, standing from the bottom of the world to the build limit, its seams still burning, and its tungsten hull and conduits can be mined back with a netherite pickaxe. The damage slider under it sets each of its hits from 2 up to ∞, and at ∞ nothing it hits survives. Its speed slider plays the whole skill, film and all, from 0.3× to 3× as fast.
key.shooting_star_demo.stellar_remote.se: The Shooting Star: SS-04 Seven Stars
Flip the cover and press the button. The Big Dipper is projected onto the land round your crosshair, seven nodes 1,440 blocks across (power 4×; from 0.1× to 10× on the slider under it), and its seven stars lock in the sky one after another. Out in Ursa Major they wake as the nodes of a stellar array and fire: their seven shooting stars come down one after another on their nodes, each digging a crater as wide as its star is bright and leaving a fallen star-core of glowing crystal in it. Then the lines of the figure ignite across the land node to node, cut as trenches with burning traces down their floors, and the whole constellation flares: the Big Dipper burned into the land. Everything where a star lands or a line burns dies, you too if you stand there (in creative the ground under your feet is spared). The damage slider under it sets each of its hits from 2 up to ∞, and at ∞ nothing it hits survives. Its speed slider plays the whole skill, film and all, from 0.3× to 3× as fast.

subtitles.shooting_star_demo.tess_emerge: A wormhole opens in the sky
Flip the cover and press the button. A cage of light in all seven colours of the spectrum, 640 blocks across at the starting power, is painted over your crosshair and grids the land inside it into 64 cells. Out of another universe a machine of hypercubes comes through a wormhole into the sky, folds itself down through the fourth dimension and lands on the square: cracks race along the grid, the land is cut free, gravity lets go, and in four waves from the middle outward every cell is torn out a full cube deep, rock and ore and caves with it, and lurches high into the sky, turning — upright, a quarter-turn, upside down, or on its side with its strata standing up. Under it the ground drops out in tiers, deeper toward the middle, the grid burning in a rainbow on every floor. Then the cage folds into itself and a wireframe tesseract of the same rainbow light is left hanging over the middle. Everything alive in the square dies, you too. Your own cell goes up with the rest (in creative you drop into the pit).
